Summary: A placeholder is a temporary visual representation of content that will be added later, used in UI/UX design to guide users and indicate where specific information or elements will be displayed. In web development, the `placeholder` attribute in HTML provides a hint to the user about the expected data type in form controls like text, search, url, tel, email, and password fields. In Bootstrap, placeholders can enhance the experience of an application and are built with HTML and CSS. In computer science, placeholders can refer to metasyntactic variables or format placeholders used in string interpolation processes.
